title: GraphDecision.v1
description: Closed output union of the deterministic VerdictInput.v1 decision function.
$comment: The program gate must derive this object solely from the exact canonical VerdictInput.v1 bytes using the reviewed priority table. A REQUESTED or QUIESCING cancellation first suspends every ordinary verdict route and yields KERNEL_CANCEL_COORDINATOR even when integrity, upstream, side-effect, blocker, or phase facts also exist; those facts remain recorded for convergence/reporting. After convergence only QUIESCENT or TERMINATED_WITH_ACTIVE_WORK may yield a cancellation terminal. Exact ROUTE reasons are: cancellation [RULE:CANCEL_REQUESTED] or [RULE:CANCEL_QUIESCING]; ordinary phase [the one matching RULE:PHASE_*]; blocking process [RULE:BLOCKING_PROCESS_BLOCKER, FACT:BLOCKER:<winning blocker_id>]. The winning blocker is the least (stage_rank, opened_event_id, blocker_id). No extra reason is allowed. reason_ids must resolve to facts in that same input; JSON Schema cannot compare two documents or establish derivation, priority, and determinism.
